objectives.en: Say every fact from two times one to two times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti two times one dé two times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from two times one reach two times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any two times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí two times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any two times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of two mangoes. Today we count in twos.
say.pcm: Look three groups of two mango. Today we go count two two.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti two mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní two two.

say.en: Today you will learn the two times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table two. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table two. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the one times table? What is one times four?
say.pcm: You remember table one? One times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table one? Kí ni one times four?

say.en: Three groups of two mangoes show this. We count two, four, six. Two times three is six.
say.pcm: See three groups of two mango: two, four, six. Two times three na six.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti two mango: two, four, six. Two times three jẹ́ six.

say.en: Say it with me: two times three is six.
say.pcm: Say am with me: two times three na six.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: two times three jẹ́ six.

say.en: Say the two times table. Start with two times one. End with two times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table two. Start with two times one. End with two times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table two. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú two times one. Parí pẹ̀lú two times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Two times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the two times table once more. Then we start the three times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table two again. Then we start table three.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table two. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table three.
